items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I remember Buddy Petit. Buddy Petit was a terrible man one time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now about Buddy Petit. I was going to ask about Buddy Petit. Do you remember him? How he played? Oh, yeah.

I remember Buddy Petit. Buddy Petit was a terrible man one time. See, Buddy was signed 20 jobs one day. They'd be looking for Buddy. Buddy would be on a lakefront playing for somebody else. People up here would be looking for Buddy. Buddy would be looking for people playing somewhere else. They'd go look Buddy up. They'd go get him out there. Like that. That's the kind of fella. Them kind of fellas.
How was he as a trumpet player?
